title: Chef Eye Goes Green!
text: All eyes on the kitchen! Spinach brings vitamin A nutrition that our eyes need!
speaker: Chef Eye

title: No Special Sauce Needed
text: Eighty grams of dry pasta, half a cup of cooked frozen spinach, one garlic clove, and two teaspoons of oil.
speaker: Narrator

title: 01 Cook Pasta and Prepare Spinach
text: Cook pasta according to its package. Cook the frozen spinach as directed, drain it, then measure!
speaker: Chef Eye

title: 02 Warm Garlic over Low Heat
text: Thinly slice the garlic. Warm it gently in oil over low heat for about thirty seconds.
speaker: Narrator

title: 03 Toss Spinach with the Pasta
text: Add cooked pasta, spinach, and a little pasta water! Toss over medium-low heat for about a minute.
speaker: Chef Eye

title: Keep It Lightly Glossy
text: Add a splash more pasta water if it looks dry. Season lightly with salt and pepper if you like.
speaker: Narrator

title: Why Eye Chose Spinach
text: Your body turns beta-carotene from spinach into vitamin A. Vitamin A is needed for the retina to detect light.
speaker: Narrator

title: How Much Vitamin A?
text: The figures shown are for cooked, drained spinach. The same volume of raw spinach is different.
speaker: Narrator

title: Just Reading the Menu Today!
text: I am not looking at the overtime schedule! Today I am only reading the menu!
speaker: Chef Eye

title: Screenshot Your Next Meal
text: Subscribe for your employee badge! Likes are your bonus!
speaker: Chef Eye
